title: Figure 20: Positronium formation and trapping in a porous material void
description: Two-panel color illustration of a positron (e+) entering a red porous material with irregular white voids; blue zigzag paths trace the particle scattering, and yellow markers labeled "Ps" show positronium forming at a void edge and becoming trapped. Caption: "Figure 20. A Positron Forms Ps on the Edge of a Void, Thermalizes, and Becomes Trapped in a Void Before Annihilating (courtesy University of Michigan)." Appears under the heading "Formation of Positronium in Porous Media."
